notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {2}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {2}.
Repeat.
